verify_detail: imply doesn\'t exist in that composition.\n\nThis means the flaky test isn\'t racing a slow animation or network call — it\'s asserting on a genuinely randomized app state that BenchTarget (by design, as a benchmark target) generates fresh on every cold launch. The fix isn\'t a `waitFor`/retry in the test; the test needs to either force the app into "Sync idle" state deterministically (e.g., via a test hook/intent extra) or assert conditionally on whichever of the two valid sync states appears.'
